summary: Configure parking capacity and fee rules
user_story: As a parking manager, I want to configure capacity and fee rules so that every parking ticket is priced consistently.
description: Create one active configuration containing total capacity, grace period, hourly rate, daily cap, lost-ticket fee, currency, and version.
acceptance_criteria: Capacity must be a positive integer.
Grace period and monetary values cannot be negative.
The active configuration can be retrieved by entry, pricing, payment, and occupancy services.
Every configuration update creates an auditable version.
